1. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: an encoder (300) for encoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence __selected from at least one of a frequency of mode usage, at least one spatial resolution, and at least one temporal resolution of one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence__.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence __and before encoding a next picture in the sequence__.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled in a bitstream__.

9. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: encoding (740, 970) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence (740, 940, 960) __selected from at least one of a frequency of mode usage, at least one spatial resolution, and at least one temporal resolution of one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence__; and signaling the adapted mode mapping information in a resultant bitstream.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after encoding one or more pictures of the sequence __and before encoding a next picture in the sequence__.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 9, wherein the picture is a currently coded picture, and the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, one or more partial encoding passes for the picture, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence (940, 960), __wherein the adapted mode mapping information is signaled in the resultant bitstream__.

17. (Currently amended) An apparatus, comprising: a decoder (400) for decoding mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence __selected from at least one of a frequency of mode usage, at least one spatial resolution, and at least one temporal resolution of one or more previously decoded pictures in the sequence__.

23. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 17, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence __and before decoding a next picture in the sequence__.

24. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 17, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously decoded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the adapted mode mapping information is determined from a bitstream__.

25. (Currently amended) A method, comprising: decoding (820, 1030) mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to decode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence __selected from at least one of a frequency of mode usage, at least one spatial resolution, and at least one temporal resolution of one or more previously decoded pictures in the sequence__; and determining the adapted mode mapping information from a resultant bitstream.

31. (Currently amended) The method of claim 25, wherein the adapted mode mapping information is updated after decoding one or more pictures of the sequence __and before decoding a next picture in the sequence__.

32. (Currently amended) The method of claim 25, wherein the actual parameters are determined from at least one of coding information for one or more previously decoded pictures in the sequence, a selected subset of a set of adapted mode mapping information relating to at least a portion of the sequence, statistics of one or more pictures in the sequence, statistics of one or more portions of the one or more pictures in the sequence, and statistics of the sequence, __wherein the adapted mode mapping information is determined from the resultant bitstream__.

33. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer-readable storage media having video signal data encoded thereupon, comprising: mode mapping information for a mapping between values of a mode index and modes available to encode at least a portion of a picture in a sequence of pictures, wherein the mode mapping information is adapted responsive to one or more actual parameters of the sequence __selected from at least one of a frequency of mode usage, at least one spatial resolution, and at least one temporal resolution of one or more previously coded pictures in the sequence__.
